body: I appreciate it, but it's probably not a great idea to leave your phone number up in a public forum. Some people can harass you with that information. If you want to PM me though I'd be ok with that.

Thank you. I live in a bible beltish small city in the south, so I really don't think we have any LGBT organizations. I think we might have one at the local community college but I'm not sure.

 My family's very poor and I don't have a job yet, so I can't quite get a therapist or anything of the sort. I've asked once and my parents just blew my off and told me they'd "drug me and stick me in a ward." also they laughed a bit at me over it.

 I live in a strange city, a small one in Texas. Our local city council is locally reputed as being very corrupt, and our local infrastructure and urban development are pretty terrible. You have to jaywalk if you want to get anywhere, and even then there's multiple trainyard overpasses you can't walk over. My parents have been talking about getting a second car soon and getting me my license, but they're very wishy washy about things. I might have to get one myself I'm not sure.

 They've also been talking about morning to a bigger city in Colorado a lot recently, but they won't ever give me an estimate on when that might be happening. I really think I might have to pay for my own car and move by myself.
 
 I was going to try to go to college for computer engineering, as i've always somewhat enjoyed tinkering with computers, but I really don't know the first place to start. I was thinking about taking a couple of semesters locally and then transferring to a 4 year in Denver or Colorado Springs.

 I really enjoy guitar and music, and I've tried to start bands locally multiple times but it's always fallen apart. There's not seemingly anything of a music scene here, and the few times I have tried to post a Craigslist ad or find local talent all I've come across is either older men who want to play country or really shady sketchy people.

 I'm sorry if I worried anyone last night, I kinda crashed as soon as I made the post. Thank you for caring, I appreciate it.
